audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[N].side read Malzahar, while content win[0..6] and the packet levelChart both read Katarina on all seven rows — and all seven full-layer whys describe Katarina winning the stage they sit under.
audit.why: Seven-for-seven cross-layer disagreement with the sentence contradicting its own row. The 52.34% win rate over 4635 games is a Katarina edge, and the content layer's reasoning (Void Shift breaks to a single dagger tick, he has no dash and no sustain) supports it.
audit.corrected: All seven sides set to Katarina, matching win[0..6] and the packet. Whys untouched — they already argue that verdict.

audit.why: Correctly recorded: level 3 dagger strings, level 6 is the Nether Grasp bait window, first item is the burst spike, late game is enter-second. His clock is Nether Grasp at 140s at rank 1 down to 80s at rank 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it despite Nether Grasp's cooldown being the entire plan. The page also treated Nether Grasp as the only threat to Death Lotus and never said that Call of the Void's silence stops the channel just as effectively on a flat 6s. dontsFull[2].t warned about 'spell-shield kits' — Void Shift is damage reduction plus CC immunity, not a spell shield. Two bullet bodies were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Katarina's R is an interruptible channel. Malzahar's Q carries the silence flag ('denies ability casts') at 900 range on a flat 6s, and his R is hardCC suppression at 700 range on 140s at rank 1. Baiting the 140s ult means nothing if the 6s silence is still up.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries Nether Grasp 140s to 80s, Call of the Void flat 6s with the silence, and Malefic Visions 11s at rank 1. tradeBad and enemyWin now state the silence. dontsFull[2] rewritten around Void Shift's actual effect.
sources: enemyKit Q cd 6 range 900 silence flag

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Check it before every step-up. - E Shunpo (second use) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Nether Grasp is 140s at rank 1 and 80s at rank 3 — point-and-click suppression at 700 range, so baiting it buys you over two minutes. - Call of the Void is a flat 6s and silences, which stops the Lotus just as dead. - Malefic Visions is 11s at rank 1.

edits.before: Q the bounce, E to the landed dagger, W as you spin out — steel-routed trades his aim can't follow.
edits.after: Q the bounce, E to the landed dagger, W as you spin out — go once Void Shift is popped off him.

edits.before: Shunpo onto a face with the CC still loaded — Katarina dies to held buttons, not skill, and everyone holding one knows it.
edits.after: Shunpo in with Call of the Void up — the silence lands on a flat 6s and your whole rotation stops where it started.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the bounce, E to the landed dagger, W as you spin out — steel-routed trades his aim can't follow. Bad trade: Shunpo onto a face with the CC still loaded — Katarina dies to held buttons, not skill, and everyone holding one knows it.
edits.after: Good trade: Q the bounce, E to the landed dagger, W as you spin out — go once Void Shift is popped off him. Bad trade: Shunpo in with Call of the Void up — the silence lands on a flat 6s and your rotation stops where it started.

edits.before: Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Bouncing Blade breaks Void Shift on contact, and with no dash anywhere in his kit he cannot walk out of the dagger zone once it is gone.

edits.before: Q the bounce, E to the landed dagger, W as you spin out — steel-routed trades his aim can't follow.
edits.after: Feint an engage so he spends Nether Grasp, then commit the real one inside its 140s cooldown.

edits.before: Malzahar spends Nether Grasp early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: With Nether Grasp spent he cannot cancel the channel for the next 140 seconds.

edits.before: That is Malzahar’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Nether Grasp is point-and-click suppression at 700 range.

edits.before: Your lotus dies to one interrupt — counting their CC before spinning is the entire skill floor of the champion.
edits.after: Malefic Visions ticks for 11s at rank 1 and spreads on a kill — a predictable pickup path just feeds it.

edits.before: All-in into spell-shield kits unbroken
edits.after: All-in while Void Shift is still up

edits.before: Shunpo onto a face with the CC still loaded — Katarina dies to held buttons, not skill, and everyone holding one knows it.
edits.after: Void Shift gives him massive damage reduction and CC immunity — your burst does a fraction of it until a dagger pops it.

edits.before: Ahead, chain it: zone Malzahar off daggers, lotus every skirmish, and reset through the map — fed Katarina is a weather event.
edits.after: Ahead, keep him shieldless: pop Void Shift every wave, take plates while he shoves, and punish every Grasp he spends.

edits.before: Carry through chain reactions — one kill is three; your job is the first domino and the discipline to wait for it.
edits.after: Carry by entering second — let Nether Grasp land on someone else, then Shunpo in and chain the resets out.

edits.before: Dagger geometry and patience — chip the no-CC kits, bait the CC ones, and bank patterns for the 6 that changes the lane's species.
edits.after: Pop Void Shift with a Bouncing Blade before every trade, sidestep the Call of the Void walls, and make each of his CS cost health.

edits.before: First item onward, hunt skirmishes: every 2v2 near your daggers is a reset chain waiting for a signature. Roam when mid stalls.
edits.after: Hold Shunpo until he casts the Q silence — with no dash and no peel, a shieldless Malzahar loses the trade. Roam when mid stalls.

edits.before: You are the cleanup that starts fights: enter on steel, lotus the clump, reset through the kill, and exit through the panic.
edits.after: Enter second: let Nether Grasp go on a teammate, then Shunpo the backline and Lotus while it sits on 80s at rank 3.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-bounced thin push with daggers banked at the river mouth — your roams arrive with luggage. Worst wave: a frozen wave near a CC mage's tower — every pickup walk is a stun audition. Crash timing: shove with a destination in mind; mid waves are bus tickets, not chores.
edits.after: Best wave: shoved onto him, since Malefic Visions pushes for him automatically but he cannot gank anyone with it. Worst wave: a wave stacked with voidlings sitting between you and your daggers. Crash timing: shove with a destination in mind; mid waves are bus tickets, not chores.

edits.before: Malzahar wins by landing Nether Grasp, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Malzahar wins by suppressing you mid-Lotus with Nether Grasp, or just silencing it away with a flat 6s Call of the Void.

edits.before: Once E is up you can Shunpo through his voidlings and kill him in the trade — his passive shield pops to one Q bounce or a dagger tick, then everything else lands for full value. Poke the shield off with Q, wait 18 seconds are not needed: any spell or dagger breaks it, then commit.
edits.after: Once E is up you can Shunpo through his voidlings and kill him in the trade — Void Shift pops to one Q bounce or a dagger tick, then everything else lands for full value. There is no timer to wait out: any spell or dagger breaks the shield, so pop it first and then commit.

notes: Seven-for-seven cross-layer chart disagreement: every full-layer phases[N].side read Malzahar while content win[0..6] and the packet levelChart both read Katarina, and every full-layer why argued the Katarina side. Fixed on the full side; no paired win[N] edit exists because the content layer was already correct. Two things I deliberately did NOT change, both recorded as unverified: (1) the page asserts in whys[5], spikes[2].text and content.late that Cleanse/QSS neutralise Nether Grasp — QSS and Cleanse eligibility is not in Riot's text and the kit's needsResearch is empty, so I left that wording alone rather than confirm or delete it; (2) the brief's missingInteractions entry claims Malefic Visions is an execute threshold. Riot's description has no threshold — it is a damage-over-time that spreads when the target dies — so the 'execute' derived flag looks like a tooltip-parsing misfire and I did not write an execute claim onto the page. dontsFull[2].t previously warned about 'spell-shield kits'; Void Shift is damage reduction plus CC immunity, not a spell shield, so the title and body are replaced. report[3].t and report[11].t still carry the old bled/spell-shield text; they are outside the sweep scope and not lint-flagged.
